remainingVerificationBoundaries: This matrix is adversarial correctness coverage, not an HTTP throughput/capacity benchmark or a claim of zero vulnerabilities.
External identity-provider credentials/session verification and production account recovery are not exercised by the trusted-principal HTTP fixture.
No hosted database, email provider, external account, object-storage policy, production renderer/worker, deployment or certificate signing was activated.

Distributed per-tenant API/render admission, isolated production PDF workers, scanner/provider capacity, privacy-safe operational monitoring and end-to-end production capacity acceptance remain deployment work. Database benchmark results alone do not establish that capacity.
PDF parsing of arbitrary uploaded legacy documents still requires the documented isolated production worker boundary; local page/input/image bounds are not a complete hostile-PDF sandbox.
The retained adult-self decision records a local policy check; it does not independently establish signer identity, legal authority in every jurisdiction, or certificate validity.
